messages:
Carmen: Heads-up — since the cross-rack packing change rolled an hour ago I'm seeing a spike of tiny warmpool pods stuck in Pending or immediately Evicted in ap-southeast1. Looks like they're landing on remote racks and tripping attach timeouts. Not sure if it's net connect or placement preference. Anyone else?
Ben: saw a few alerts, +1. pods are small (0.25 GPU) and seem to prefer racks with warm nodes but then fail during attach. short logs: 'attach timeout after 12s' and 'device not found' so might be race on init.
Isha: Can you paste the k8s describe for one of them? also which scheduler patch rolled — the cross-rack weight change?
Carmen: pasted an anonymized describe below:

```
Events:
  Type     Reason             Age   From               Message
  ----     ------             ----  ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling   2m    default-scheduler  0/24 nodes are available: 5 node(s) had untolerated taint, 11 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu, 8 too many of requested nic attachments.
  Normal   Scheduled          1m    default-scheduler  Successfully assigned default/mini-task-7 to rack-17-node-03
  Warning  FailedAttach      30s   kubelet            rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = failed to attach device
  Normal   Evicted           10s   eviction-controller  NodeAffinity mismatch -> Evicted
```

Ben: interesting — scheduled then FailedAttach. That smells like cross-rack NVLink/attacher path difference. Recent change adjusted inter-rack preference to preferRemote when packing density high.
Tanvi: we saw attach latency go up 2x on cross-rack paths in telemetry. If a tiny pod lands on a rack where the attach-controller's node affinitized driver container is cold it times out.
Isha: tl;dr: scheduler is deciding placement first then attach failing -> node draining? Could be pod pinned to warm pool label that exists in multiple racks but only some have the attach service warm.
Carmen: ops plan suggestion: 1) temporarily revert the cross-rack preferRemote tweak, 2) add a short backoff/retry in the attach-controller (2 retries with 3s), 3) pin mini warmpool pods to same-rack affinity for now. Thoughts?
Ben: +1 to revert as quick mitigation. Also we should run a quick canary to ensure it actually cuts the FailedAttach rate.
Isha: I can flip the feature flag on scheduler to revert—will need a 2-min window. I'll run a canary in ap-southeast1c only.
buildbot: deploy-bot: scheduler/weighting-feature-flag reverted in ap-southeast1c (deploy id: d-2026-0311-57). See https://ci.redwood/run/12233 :white_check_mark:
Tanvi: after revert, attach latency graphs look better (30m window). evictions dropped from ~4/min to ~0.4/min. Good signal.
Carmen: Thanks — big improvement. For follow-up: propose we change warmpool pod placement policy to score same-rack + warmnode-first, and make attach-controller robust with more retries and a short jitter. Also add a readiness probe on attach-service so scheduler can avoid racks with cold attachers.
Ben: I'll open two PRs: one for scheduler scoring tweak (prefer same-rack warmnode, softer remote fallback) and one for attach-controller retry/jitter. Assigning to me and Tanvi for review.
Isha: and I'll add a short runbook entry: if evictions spike for mini-warmpool, check scheduler flag and attach errors, and revert if >2x attach failures over 10m.
Tanvi: sounds good. Also let's tag capacity-engineering to look at why some racks' attach service is slower — might be host-level egress or VM hotspot.
Carmen: thanks team. leaving this thread open for PR links and post-mortem notes. :thumbsup:
